title: Pressure-Cooked Curry Chicken Breast
description: Two chopped chicken breasts pressure-cooked in a cumin, curry, coriander, dark soy sauce and hạt nêm broth. Quick prep with 17 minutes at pressure.

ingredients.name: Chicken breasts
ingredients.note: Chopped; about 400 g total assumed for nutrition

steps.text: Chop both chicken breasts into pieces.
Put the chopped chicken in the pressure cooker. Add the cumin, curry powder, coriander, dark soy sauce, hạt nêm and 250 mL water. Mix thoroughly.
Heat the pressure cooker at 2000 W until it reaches full pressure and the valve starts moving.
Reduce the hob to 600 W and pressure-cook for 17 minutes, starting the timer when full pressure is reached. Let the cooker depressurize safely before opening.

notes: Nutrition assumes 400 g raw skinless chicken breast total and about 670 g finished dish including the broth; actual values vary with breast size, seasoning brand and final weight.
Pressure release method wasn't specified in the original recipe; release pressure according to the cooker's instructions.
